title: The journalist Siti Marlina was accused of speaking hate
paragraphs: Our Lombok journalist, Siti Marlina, was charged with hate talks related to a land conflict between two groups of citizens.
According to the charges, Siti Marlina published news of a land conflict between two groups of citizens on December 22, 2025, judged by prosecutors, spreading hatred against a particular group.
The prosecution was read at the Mataram State Court on January 26, 2026, the first hearing of the witness hearing was scheduled on February 16, 2026.
In the matter of Siti Marlina, Hasan Basri's legal power was denied access to a number of case files so that the defense rights were compromised.
Siti Marlina works as our Lombok journalist in Mataram, a journalist's organization assessing that this case can have a lesson in the freedom of the press.
The threat of punishment for this chapter is up to six years in prison.
